Class RemotePF

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.pf.RemotePF
public final class RemotePF extends Object
A LEGO Power Functions infrared remote (8885), which drives the motors, lights and servos plugged into an IR Receiver (8884) set to one of its four channels. The commands are plain Java on top of a PFLink, which frames them and sends them through an infrared emitter (HX-53 or Grove).

Each receiver has two outputs, PFPort.RED and PFPort.BLUE, and the receiver's channel switch must match the PFChannel argument. Sending is blocking. Works on both boards. The pulse timings follow the published protocol and have not been verified on a receiver.

Create one PFLink at startup, call its begin once, and create the remote with it.

  • Method Details

    • setSpeed

      public void setSpeed(PFChannel channel, PFPort port, int speed)
      Runs port of the receiver on channel at speed, -7..7: positive for one direction, negative for the other, 0 lets it coast. Out-of-range values are clamped.

    • brake

      public void brake(PFChannel channel, PFPort port)
      Actively brakes port, unlike setSpeed(channel, port, 0), which lets it coast.

    • setSpeeds

      public void setSpeeds(PFChannel channel, int redSpeed, int blueSpeed)
      Sets both outputs of the receiver on channel in one message, each -7..7 as in setSpeed(PFChannel, PFPort, int). It is a single command, so use it to start two motors together.

    • stop

      public void stop(PFChannel channel)
      Lets both outputs of the receiver on channel coast.
